text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... If I'm not mistaken... were you 
looking for me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. I'm sorry... I tend to blend 
into the background.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't mind it...! It happens 
all the time, really...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Automatic doors not opening for me, people 
skipping ahead of me in line... It really 
is just an everyday occurrence...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(To remain inconspicuous, to stay out of 
everyone's sight.\nBecause that... is my 
wish as well.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can't find me, I will find 
you. So... it's all right, Trainer.
